vīvō

vīvō, vīvere, vīxī, vīctum

verb, third conjugation

live, be alive; live (somewhere, in some way)

In this lexicon

  • live

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Haut. 429: valet atque vīvit; Cic. Sen. 24: annum … posse vīvere

  • live

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 14.20.4: vīvit habitatque cum Balbō (Lewis & Short)

Examples

    How are my children, whom I left here, my son and my daughter? — Alive and well.Plaut. Trin. 1074–1075
